cohort: 1901 pregnant women in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China
finding: The age-standardized incidence of GDM was 18.3%, increasing with maternal age and prepregnancy BMI, and GDM was associated with several adverse delivery outcomes, including longer hospital stay, shorter gestation at delivery, higher cesarean delivery rate, and increased risk of macrosomia, small for gestational age, and neonatal intensive care unit admission.
mod_finding: Women with GDM had a higher risk of cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Macrosomic or small for gestational age
